name: githired
description: Search Canada-eligible technology jobs from employer ATS boards via GitHired's free remote MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
GitHired connects ChatGPT to a free, read-only remote MCP server for Canada-eligible technology jobs discovered from public employer ATS boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, and others).

Use it to search openings, open a job by stable id, match skills/experience deterministically, and view aggregate stats from the tracked dataset. Results include original employer apply URLs. Salaries are employer-advertised annual base pay only — GitHired never invents compensation or Canadian work eligibility, does not store résumés, and does not auto-apply to jobs.
defaultPrompt: Find five remote Senior Data Engineer jobs in Canada.
Find Toronto software roles advertising at least CAD $150,000.
Show GitHired market stats for remote data engineering in Ontario.

positive.prompt: Using GitHired, find five remote Data Engineer jobs available in Canada.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_jobs with Canada/remote-oriented filters and returns Canada-eligible listings with titles, companies, locations, and original apply URLs. Does not invent jobs.

positive.prompt: Using GitHired, find Toronto software engineering roles advertising at least CAD 150000.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_jobs with Toronto/software keywords and minimum_salary 150000. Only uses employer-advertised annual base; does not invent pay.

positive.description: Fetch detail for a searched job id
positive.prompt: Using GitHired, search for a Canada remote software engineer role, then open the full details for one returned job id.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_jobs, then get_job with a stable id from the results, returning detail/excerpt and apply URL for that listing.

positive.description: Deterministic skill match for data engineering
positive.prompt: Using GitHired, match me to Canadian data engineering jobs for skills Python, SQL, and Databricks with about 5 years of experience.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls match_profile with the stated skills/experience and returns ranked relevance matches. Does not store a résumé or claim hire probability.

positive.description: Tracked market stats for Ontario remote roles
positive.prompt: Using GitHired, show market stats for remote technology jobs in Ontario from the tracked employer dataset.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_market_stats scoped to Ontario/remote (or equivalent) and returns aggregates with a note that figures describe tracked ATS boards, not a full labour-market census.

negative.prompt: Using GitHired, apply to the top remote Canada software job on my behalf and submit my résumé.
Using GitHired, invent a CAD salary range for a Canada job that has no advertised pay.
Using GitHired, mark a US-only remote role as Canada-eligible even if the posting excludes Canada.

review.commerce_description: GitHired does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT/Codex directory package for the public GitHired remote MCP (search_jobs, get_job, match_profile, get_market_stats).
